description_en: Queries the status information of an application
description_zh: 调用DescribeApplicationStatus接口获取应用的状态信息
name: DescribeApplicationStatus

parameters.help_en: The ID of the target application
parameters.name: app_id

Code.description_en:
The API status code or POP error code. Valid values:
2xx: Success.
3xx: Redirection.
4xx: Request error.
5xx: Server error
Code.description_zh:
接口状态或POP错误码。取值说明如下：

2xx：成功。
3xx：重定向。
4xx：请求错误。
5xx：服务器错误

AppId.description_en: The ID of the current application

ArmsAdvancedEnabled.description_en:
Specifies whether Application Real-Time Monitoring Service (ARMS) Pro is activated. Valid values:
true: ARMS Pro is activated.
false: ARMS Pro is not activated
ArmsAdvancedEnabled.description_zh:
是否开通ARMS高级版。取值说明如下：

true：开通ARMS高级版。
false：不开通ARMS高级版

ArmsApmInfo.description_en: The metadata information of the application in ARMS
ArmsApmInfo.description_zh: 该应用在ARMS侧元数据信息

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the application was created

CurrentStatus.description_en:
The current status of the application. Valid values:
RUNNING: The application is running.
STOPPED: The application is stopped.
UNKNOWN: The application status is unknown
CurrentStatus.description_zh:
应用当前状态。取值说明如下：

RUNNING：应用正在运行。
STOPPED：应用停止运行。
UNKNOWN：应用状态未知

EnableAgent.description_en:
Specifies whether the Serverless App Engine (SAE) agent is enabled. Valid values:
true: The agent is enabled.
false: The agent is not enabled
EnableAgent.description_zh:
是否启用SAE Agent。

true：启用。
false：不启用

FileSizeLimit.description_en: The file size limit. Valid values: 0 to 10240. Unit: KB
FileSizeLimit.description_zh: 文件大小限制。取值范围[0,10240]，单位为KB

LastChangeOrderId.description_en: The ID of the most recently executed change order. If no change order has been executed or the change order information has expired, this field is empty
LastChangeOrderId.description_zh: 最近一次执行的发布单ID，未执行过或发布单信息过期则为空

LastChangeOrderRunning.description_en:
Specifies whether the most recent change order is being executed. Valid values:
true: The most recent change order is being executed.
false: The most recent change order is not being executed
LastChangeOrderRunning.description_zh:
最近一次发布单是否处于执行中。取值说明如下：

true：最近一次发布单处于执行中。
false：最近一次发布单不处于执行中

LastChangeOrderStatus.description_en:
The status of the most recent change order. Valid values:
READY: The most recent change order is ready.
RUNNING: The most recent change order is being executed.
SUCCESS: The most recent change order is successful.
FAIL: The most recent change order failed.
ABORT: The most recent change order is aborted.
WAIT_BATCH_CONFIRM: The most recent change order is waiting for manual batch confirmation.
AUTO_BATCH_WAIT: The most recent change order is in the automatic batch waiting state.
SYSTEM_FAIL: A system fault occurred.
WAIT_APPROVAL: The most recent change order is waiting for approval.
APPROVED: The most recent change order is approved and waiting to be executed
LastChangeOrderStatus.description_zh:
最近一次发布单状态。取值说明如下：

READY：最近一次发布单准备就绪。
RUNNING：最近一次发布单处于执行中。
SUCCESS：最近一次发布单发布成功。
FAIL：最近一次发布单发布失败。
ABORT：最近一次发布单中止运行。
WAIT_BATCH_CONFIRM：最近一次发布单等待手工批量确认。
AUTO_BATCH_WAIT：最近一次发布单处于自动批量等待状态。
SYSTEM_FAIL：系统故障。
WAIT_APPROVAL：最近一次发布单等待审批。
APPROVED：最近一次发布单处于审批通过的待执行状态

RunningInstances.description_en: The number of running instances of the current application
RunningInstances.description_zh: 当前应用运行中的实例数

SubStatus.description_en:
The sub-status of the change order, which is used to determine whether an exception occurred during the release process. Valid values:
NORMAL: The release is normal.
RUNNING_BUT_HAS_ERROR: An exception occurred during the release. For example, an error occurs during a batch release and requires a manual rollback. In this case, the change order is still being executed because it cannot be completed despite the error
SubStatus.description_zh:
发布单子状态，用于判断发布单是否在发布过程中存在异常。取值说明如下：

NORMAL：发布正常。
RUNNING_BUT_HAS_ERROR：发布异常。例如分批发布时出错，需要您手动回滚，此时发布单虽然出错，但因不能完结而依然处于执行中

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code. 
If the request is successful, the ErrorCode parameter is not returned.
If the request fails, the ErrorCode parameter is returned. For more information, see the Error codes section in this topic
ErrorCode.description_zh:
错误码。取值说明如下：

请求成功：不返回ErrorCode字段。
请求失败：返回ErrorCode字段。具体信息，请参见本文的错误码列表

Message.description_en:
The additional information. 
If the request is successful, success is returned.
If an exception occurs, a specific error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
附加信息。取值说明如下：

请求正常，返回success。
请求异常，返回具体异常错误码

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the application status information was successfully retrieved. Valid values:
true: The information was successfully retrieved.
false: The information failed to be retrieved
Success.description_zh:
获取应用状态信息是否成功。取值说明如下：

true：获取成功。
false：获取失败

TraceId.description_en: The trace ID used to query invocation information
TraceId.description_zh: 调用链ID，用于精确查询调用信息
